info.name: MerchVision - PRAN-RFL Retail Merchandising & Token Analytics API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman API Collection for the **PRAN-RFL Retail Merchandising & Shelf Intelligence System**.

### Backend Base URL
- **Base URL:** `http://172.17.4.199:8093/` (or `http://172.17.4.199:8093`)
- **Health Check:** `http://172.17.4.199:8093/health`
- **Swagger Docs:** `http://172.17.4.199:8093/docs`
- **ReDoc:** `http://172.17.4.199:8093/redoc`
- **Interactive Web UI:** `http://172.17.4.199:8093/ui`

### Module Architecture
1. **System & Health:** Health checks, Web UI dashboard, OpenAPI schemas.
2. **Single-Call Perception / Survey:** Instant AI detection returning product counts, tokens, and cost.
3. **Asynchronous Uploads & Polling:** Background task queue for high-volume store photo uploads.
4. **Analytics & Survey History:** Summary token usage, total costs, top detected SKUs.
5. **Retail Merchandising & Shelf Audits:** Share of Shelf (SoS %), Retail Execution Scoring (RES 0-100 across 6 pillars), planogram compliance, out-of-stock gaps, management dashboard.
6. **Master Items Catalogue:** Hybrid BM25/Vector search against 1,985 PRAN-RFL SKUs (`itemsdb.csv`).
7. **Token Router & AI Telemetry:** Gemini 3.7 Flash specs, token estimator, live token counting, and cost breakdown.

item.name: 5. Retail Merchandising Shelf Audit & Intelligence
item.description:
Commercial retail shelf auditing module.
- Image-only PRAN product detection and facing quantification.
- Decoupled brand classification (PRAN vs. Competitor).
- Master catalogue matching against itemsdb.csv (1,985 SKUs).
- Share of Shelf (SoS %) & Eye-Level Share.
- Deterministic Retail Execution Score (RES 0-100) across 6 commercial pillars.
- Management Dashboard with Exception-First outlet rankings.
